content:
It's not forcing that view, it's just respecting the options you've chosen (maybe unintentionally.) Explore the settings found in menu option <View | Sort by>. I'm guessing you have "Grouped By Sort" turned on.

You might also want to check out Card View (your current message list view) vs. Table View. See <Settings | Appearance | Message List>.
